messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: we need a single-source onboarding checklist that covers handbook updates, mandatory compliance training, and hiring ops integration for US/UK/DE hires. Goal: have a Confluence template + CSV header for hiring-ops to use by end of week.

oliver: I can draft the Confluence template. Quick Q: should contractors get the same handbook overview as full-time employees?

maria: Not exactly. Contractors need Data Privacy + Security baseline only. Full-time employees get the full handbook + role-specific regs. We need an explicit 'required_by_engagement' field.

ben: Suggest fields for CSV: email,legal_name,engagement,role,team,location,start_date,handbook_refs,required_courses,manager_approval_needed,notes. That should map cleanly to our ATS export.

oliver: Nice. I'll start a template section per country with handbook IDs so People Ops can link to the exact paragraph. Example: US-HB_3_SectionA, UK-HB_1B, DE-HB_2. Also include a 'local_actions' list (works council, tax forms) for DE.

tasha: For LMS mapping: course keys are DP-PRIV (privacy), SEC-BASIC (security), HB-OVERVIEW (handbook overview). Contractors: DP-PRIV + SEC-BASIC. Employees: all three + role-triggered courses.

maria: Add rule: SEC-BASIC must be completed within 7 calendar days for infra/devops roles. Mark as "immediate" in the CSV for those roles.

ben: We'll need a manager-approval flow for exemptions (medical, legal) and an audit log entry. Can People Ops own the approval gate?

maria: Yes. People Ops will be approver-of-record. Tasha, can LMS accept "manager_approved_exemption" flag so the bot won't auto-escalate nudges?

tasha: Yep, LMS can skip nudges if that flag is present. We'll track approver and timestamp in the LMS meta but not in the CSV export (privacy).

hr-bot: Reminder: "Assign required onboarding courses within 48 hours." Next run: 2026-05-01 08:00 UTC.

oliver: One more ask 1: add a checkbox in the hiring form "EOR arrangement" that auto-sets engagement=EOR and wires to local EOR checklist. Saves ops from manual edits.

maria: Good. Add to the Confluence template a short troubleshooting section for common hiring ops mistakes (wrong engagement, missing passport docs for DE, forgotten works council notice).

ben: I'll update our ATS export script to output the CSV header and a sample row so hiring-ops has an example.

maria: Action items:
- oliver: Confluence template per country + sample handbook ref IDs (due 48h)
- tasha: LMS mapping + exemption handling details (due 72h)
- ben: ATS CSV header + sample export (due 48h)
- maria: Write exemption wording and add to People Ops playbook (due end of week)

oliver: I'll post the first draft in Confluence and ping this channel.

tasha: Will share the LMS payload example and the nudge cadence recommendations.

ben: ETA 36h for the CSV sample.

maria: Thanks everyone. Please keep comments on the Confluence page so hiring-ops channel doesn't get noisy. Closing this thread once the Confluence draft exists. :white_check_mark:
